notes: The D50D/D70D parts list and wiring diagram include a water pump. The parts list covers the D50D and D70D.

gaps: The manual names Friedrich only; it does not say who built the unit.
The voltage and current are whole-unit figures, so they are not put on any part.

The parts list carries three micro switches (679-041-00 at refs 8 and 26, 679-041-10 at ref 29) without saying which one the bucket float works, so the 'switch' entry lists them all; the troubleshooting table names a broken micro switch as a cause of water overflow.

The 'SENSOR' part (679-041-19) is filed as the humidity sensor because it is listed separately from the 'THERMISTOR SENSOR' and the wiring diagram shows an H.sensor and a T.sensor; that pairing is an interpretation, so the part entries don't state it.
method: Source is Friedrich's 'Service & Parts Manual, Dehumidifier, Models D25D, D50D, D70D' (footer 'Dehumidifier-2010 Svc Parts (4-2010)'), hosted as a PDF by the parts retailer Appliance Factory Parts, which adds its own cover sheet as PDF page 1; page numbers below are PDF pages.
Read as text and checked against rendered images of the D50D spec page (PDF p.7), the D50D/D70D wiring diagram (PDF p.10) and the D50D/D70D service parts list (PDF p.14) on 2026-11-12.
D50D figures: 50 pints/day at 80 F / 60% RH, 115 V 60 Hz, 5.9 A running current, R410A 9.32 oz, 16-pint tank.

comps.spec: Compressor model 35D052-A2-ABLL, Friedrich part 679-041-25 (compressor ass'y); R410A 9.32 oz
Compressor capacitor 40 uF / 300 V, Friedrich part 679-041-12
Fan motor model LS-16T2-02-N2, 47 W input, two speeds (FAN-L / FAN-H), Friedrich part 679-041-22; blower wheel 679-041-58
Plastic fan motor capacitor 6 uF / 250 V, Friedrich part 679-041-14
Micro switches 679-041-00 (listed at refs 8 and 26) and 679-041-10 (ref 29); bucket float 679-041-63 with float cap 679-041-64
Sensor, Friedrich part 679-041-19, listed separately from the thermistor sensor; the D50D/D70D wiring diagram shows an H.sensor and a T.sensor
Water pump, Friedrich part 679-041-01, with push-button switch for pump 679-041-03, pump hose connector 679-041-04 and quick connector for pump 679-041-02; wiring diagram shows a pump protector
Electronic control board, Friedrich part 679-041-15; control panel 679-041-16
Fuse marked T3.15AL 125V, drawn on the circuit board with connectors CN1 to CN8 in the D50D/D70D wiring diagram
